definitions.gloss: patiently; taking one's time; without rushing
definitions.explanation: Doing something at a relaxed pace without hurrying or becoming frustrated. Implies a calm, unhurried approach.

examples.japanese: {気長|きなが}に{返事|へんじ}を{待|ま}ちましょう。
examples.english: Let's wait patiently for a reply.

examples.japanese: {語学|ごがく}の{上達|じょうたつ}には{時間|じかん}がかかるので、{気長|きなが}に{続|つづ}けることが{大事|だいじ}だ。
examples.english: Improving at a language takes time, so it's important to keep at it patiently.

notes:
USAGE:
{気長|きなが}に is most commonly followed by {待|ま}つ (to wait). The base form {気長|きなが} can also be used as a na-adjective meaning patient or easygoing: {気長|きなが}な{人|ひと} (a patient person), {気長|きなが}な{性格|せいかく} (an easygoing personality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気長|きなが}に{待|ま}つ (to wait patiently)
- {気長|きなが}に{続|つづ}ける (to continue patiently)
- {気長|きなが}に{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to deal with something patiently)
- {気長|きなが}な{人|ひと} (a patient person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{気短|きみじか} is the antonym, meaning short-tempered or impatient: {気短|きみじか}な{人|ひと} (an impatient person).
